description: A WPF WebView2 created in code hangs during initialization until it is added to the control tree, based on https://stackoverflow.com/questions/65139090/how-can-i-initialize-the-webview2-in-wpf.
prompt:
I'm creating a WebView2 in code because my HTML is in memory. `EnsureCoreWebView2Async(null)` never returns, and there is no exception even if I wait a long time.

I don't want to write the HTML to disk or set a real `Source` URL just to initialize it.
